sentence: This project studies how one amino acid substitutes for another in proteins and uses this to improve software that reconstructs the tree of life.
This project studies how individual training examples shape the way modern machine learning systems learn and tries to make them more stable.
This project builds methods that use deep learning and signal processing to tell wireless devices apart from their radio signals.
This project rebuilds a digital database of the fossil record so that fossil data and specimen images are easier to add, use and share.
This project builds a soft robotic gripper made of shells that use air pressure to pick up and release small, delicate objects.
This project builds a system that uses radio tags on gear to track shellfish growth and help farmers make better decisions.
This project builds a robot assistant that learns to recognize what a person is trying to do and hands them the right object at the right time.
This project builds ways to collect images and process them to detect cancer, and designs bio-inspired computing systems.
This project studies how to measure and compare the condition of coastal wetlands and builds ways to monitor, model and restore them.
This project builds ranking methods that explain their own reasoning and stay balanced and robust, using neuro-symbolic learning.
This project develops and manufactures grid technologies, such as transformers, circuit breakers and inverters, for the electric grid.
This project tries to find which genes control how plants interact with their microbiome in a model legume.
This project studies whether virtual reality can help people learn to spot and fix cybersecurity threats in additive manufacturing.
This project designs control methods that help underwater robots with arms stay stable and keep working when unforeseen events happen.
This project uses DNA left in the environment to study the variety of organisms in cave groundwater and how human impacts affect them.
This project works on making programs run faster, making computers more secure, and making artificial intelligence and quantum computers more practical.
This project builds interactive tools, such as chatbots, that use large language models and a knowledge graph to teach cybersecurity.
This project uses machine learning to gather data on fossil and living plants and finds out what drove the rapid rise of flowering plants.
